title: XenOnScroll
tagline: XEN is a fair crypto project which is currently deploying 12 blockchains. XEN is based on the ERC20 token standard with a minimum amount of code. There are no pre-minting, hidden doors, admin keys, or origin (OA) wallets.
description: XEN is a fair crypto project that allows participants to start minting their XEN cryptocurrency without the need to deposit any funds. XEN has an initial supply of zero and relies solely on the participating community for minting. There is no maximum cap on the supply, and it follows an inflationary trend in the beginning, gradually transitioning into a disinflationary model as adoption increases.
how_its_made: The project incorporates the Hardhat tool and upholds the recommended framework's basic structure. For the smart contract aspect, I utilized the contract that has already been deployed on 12 blockchains. To deploy the contracts, I created a script that takes the contract instance as input and initiates its deployment on the Scroll testnet network. To verify the contract, I inserted the Etherscan API key in the hardhat.config.js file and employed specific Hardhat commands.
